summary: Phase 2 Interlinked Fields Testing Complete — Checkbox/Radio + Two-Way Direction. All 47 backend tests passed (18 Phase 2 + 8 Phase 81.49 + 9 Phase 81.50 + 12 Phase 81.51). Code review verified: (1) value_key_for helper returns groupName for radio fields, (2) direction='two_way' triggers reverse fanout, (3) two-way cascade propagates to other targets, (4) read_only_target blocks reverse fanout, (5) frontend supports checkbox/radio in interlink UI with 'Linked Group' label for radios, (6) direction toggle with data-testids, (7) mutual exclusivity between Two-Way and Lock linked target.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ package_public_routes.py: value_key_for(p) helper correctly returns groupName for radio fields, else placement id (lines 1299-1303)
✅ package_public_routes.py: Forward fanout uses value_key_for for both source and target keys (lines 1331-1366)
✅ package_public_routes.py: Reverse fanout triggered when direction='two_way' (lines 1375-1393)
✅ package_public_routes.py: Two-way cascade propagates to other siblings after reverse (lines 1423-1444)
✅ package_public_routes.py: Logger messages for [Interlink] Forward fanout, Reverse fanout (two-way), Two-way cascade
✅ MultiPageVisualBuilder.js: Radio group dedupe by groupName with 'Group: {key}' label (lines 132-143)
✅ MultiPageVisualBuilder.js: Lock checkbox disabled when direction='two_way' (line 2022)
✅ MultiPageVisualBuilder.js: Locking target resets direction to 'one_way' (line 2027)
✅ PackagePublicView.js: Reverse fanout checks direction='two_way' and read_only_target !== true (line 554)
seed_data_creation: Created test templates with checkbox/radio fields and linked_to.direction='two_way' configurations for API testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 Interlinked Fields extends Phase 81.49/50/51 with: (1) Checkbox/Radio field support — radio uses groupName as storage key via value_key_for helper, (2) Two-Way direction toggle — enables bidirectional sync, mutually exclusive with Lock linked target, (3) Reverse fanout — when a two-way target is saved, the source doc is updated and forward fanout cascades to other targets. All code review tests verify the implementation is correct. For E2E testing of actual fanout behavior, create a package with 2+ templates where Template B has fields linked to Template A with direction='two_way', then sign Template B first and verify Template A's field_data is updated.

checkbox_radio_support.details: Checkbox uses placement id as storage key; Radio uses groupName as storage key via value_key_for helper

two_way_direction.details: Direction toggle with One-Way (default) and Two-Way options; Two-Way triggers reverse fanout

reverse_fanout.details: When two-way target is saved, source doc is updated; read_only_target blocks reverse

two_way_cascade.details: After reverse fanout, forward fanout propagates from source to other targets

mutual_exclusivity.details: Two-Way clears read_only_target; Locking target resets direction to one_way
